question: How did David decide to share the plunder?
options: Only those who fought would share
David would keep most of it
Those who stayed with the supplies would share equally with those who fought
It would all go to the elders of Judah
explanation: When some men said those who stayed behind should get nothing, David said, "The share of the man who stayed with the supplies is to be the same as that of him who went down to the battle. All will share alike."
